rows.en: So that's it...
Ankh tried to grab the blue stone.
But a strange power held it fast to the statue, and it couldn't be removed.
Damn it!! It's no good, it won't budge.
As I thought, we need the power of an Ultra Warrior.
Just as I thought, we need the power of an Ultra Warrior.
Figures. We need the power of an Ultra Warrior.
So we do need the power of an Ultra Warrior...
Told ya. We need one of them Ultra Warriors after all, don't we?
So that's it...
All right, I'll take it.
Mebius reached out to the statue and grabbed the blue stone!
All right, I'll take it.
Zero reached out to the statue and grabbed the blue stone!
Obtained the blue stone.
Looks like you got your hands on the blue stone!
Now, quick, throw it into the nest!
Throw the blue stone in?
{8074} threw the blue stone into Antlar's nest!
Kyiaaaaahhh~~~!!
{8074} stared at Antlar's nest, still clutching the blue stone.
Antlar's nest vanished!
You did it.
The Ride Gate looks like it's in good shape.
Now if we can just finish the Ride Machine...
00, what's wrong?
The operation plan has been decided.
I need everyone to gather at the camp immediately.
...Well then, everyone, let's hurry to the camp.
{8074} and the team moved to camp.
...So, our ultimate goal is to strike the enemy's home base, but
to do that, we've gotta head out into the Ride Dungeon and take down the Psycho Gundam.
Just then, 00 came running up to the heroes.
The Psycho Gundam...!!
The enemy's even got something like that...
You know it?
The enemy's even got something like that...
...But it's a Gundam, right?
It looks like a Gundam, but... it's far bigger and more powerful than any of us.
Sounds like it's gonna give us a hard time...
...So, about how we beat that Psycho Gundam: we absolutely need to build a new "Ride Machine."
We absolutely need to build a new "Ride Machine."
A Ride Machine?
It's a ship for traveling through the Ride Dungeon and fighting the enemy.
We've been building it on the Ptolemaios, which got wrecked in our last operation, but
if we finish it with only our own tech, chances are we'll just end up like last time.
But thanks to the help of Ultraman Hikari and you guys on the Hero Team,
it looks like we can finish a Ride Machine that can handle any situation.
I see. So, what's this operation plan?
I'll explain that part.
Put simply, this operation is about "gathering the materials needed to complete the Ride Machine."
We've been investigating the enemy's territory for some time...
And we discovered that this Cube has absorbed a wide variety of materials.
However, many of them were things whose properties and uses we couldn't identify.
But now that we've shared information with you, we've found that several of them...
would be useful for building a more powerful Ride Machine.
And what are these materials?
Hikari, could you explain the rest?
Very well. First, there's "Emerium ore."
First, there's "Emerium ore."
Emerium ore!?
You know it well, don't you, Zero?
...It's what Planet Esmeralda is made of. The stuff itself is a source of super-energy... right?
It's what Planet Esmeralda is made of. The stuff itself is a source of super-energy... right?
Exactly. We want to use it as a power source.
We'll use it as the Ride Machine's main source of energy.
Whoa, that's something... The output's gotta be insane.
Next, "Gundanium alloy." We can use this to reinforce the armor.
We can use this to reinforce the armor.
Our investigation found that the enemy is refining Gundanium alloy at a facility inside the Cube,
and that they're holding an extremely high-purity supply of it.
Last of all, there's weaponry...
We'll storm the enemy's storehouse and seize anything that looks usable.
...Those three, materials and equipment, are our targets.
Normally, we'd have had no choice but to attack these three sites one at a time,
but this time, with the Hero Team's help, we can hit them all at once.
That way, the enemy will be forced to split up its forces.
On top of that, Celestial Being will act as a decoy and draw the enemy in.
Meanwhile, the Hero Team will push into the designated points and seize the materials.

notes.note: Rows 0223-0224 are legacy (older-script) variants of the 0222 statue scene. 0223.3 mis-decoded kanji read as 'fixed' (held fast), matching 0222.6. Legacy calls it just 'the blue stone' (no 'of Baraj'); kept as written.
0223.5-9 are party-leader variants of 'we need an Ultra Warrior's power'; voiced by label (Nu calm, Zeta, Shotaro 'Figures', OOO soft, Momotaros rough).
Legacy variant gives Mebius the rough 'yosh, ore ga torou' (Zero-style) instead of his polite line in 0222.18; translated neutrally as written for both Mebius and Zero.

0225 is NOT flagged legacy but is fully mis-decoded (wrong-encoding kanji). Meaning inferred from the matching 0217 Antlar-nest scene: blue stone obtained / quick, throw it into the nest / throw it in? / threw it into Antlar's nest / roar / stared while clutching it / nest vanished / 'yatta na'. Speaker labels here (00, Zeta, Waste Yummy) look mis-mapped; 0225.1's gentle 'ne' ending suggests Arios, 0225.7 is Antlar's roar.
Antlar's roar rendered 'Kyiaaaaahhh~~~!!'; no earlier English precedent (story_026 0217.10 has the same roar, not yet translated) - keep consistent.
'Yatta na' (label Zeta, likely mis-mapped) rendered 'You did it.' praising the player; 0217 counterpart is Arios's 'Did we get it!'.
00 asking the heroes to come: 'I need everyone to gather...' (subject restored).
'Psycho Gundam' not in glossary; standard English name used.
Narration '00 came running up to the heroes' sits oddly after Cherudim's lines (likely unused/alt ordering); translated as written.
Unlabelled variant of Zeta's line #0.16; same wording given.
Zeta speaks politely (desu) to Shotaro here; kept neutral-polite. 'Oretachi' = the Gundams, rendered 'any of us'.
Seravee (Tieria) uses 'boku' here; rendered plainly 'I'll explain that part.'
'Planet Esmeralda' not in glossary; established Ultraman Zero English name.
'Hokanko' rendered 'storehouse'; next slice's operation C ('Buso Hokanko' raid) should align (e.g. 'Weapons Storehouse').
'The above three materials/equipment' = two materials plus the weapons; rendered 'Those three, materials and equipment, are our targets.'

report: 80/80 rows. 0225 (not flagged legacy) is fully mis-decoded; meaning inferred from the 0217 Antlar-nest scene, speaker labels there look mis-mapped. Legacy 0223.3 'fixed' inferred. Not in glossary: Psycho Gundam, Planet Esmeralda, Antlar roar 'Kyiaaaaahhh~~~!!', 'storehouse' for hokanko.
